knowledgeBase.title: Order Confirmation & Gateway Payment Sync
knowledgeBase.summary: Handling UPI/card payment deductions where order status remains Payment Pending.
knowledgeBase.content: If a customer paid via UPI or card and their order still shows "Payment Deducted (Pending Sync)", inspect the order with lookup_order and run sync_pending_payment immediately to confirm the order and dispatch it to fulfillment.

knowledgeBase.title: Duplicate Card Charge Auto-Refund Policy
knowledgeBase.summary: Verifying double settlements and issuing immediate refunds.
knowledgeBase.content: When a customer reports a double charge, inspect their orders via lookup_order. If an order has paymentStatus "Duplicate Charge", call issue_order_refund for the duplicate invoice. Refunds at or below the auto-refund cap execute instantly; higher amounts queue for Priya S. approval.

knowledgeBase.title: 14-Day Size Exchange & Return Label Policy
knowledgeBase.summary: Free size exchanges and prepaid return labels on delivered orders.
knowledgeBase.content: Delivered garments within 14 days qualify for a free size exchange or return label. Use initiate_exchange_or_return with action "exchange" (and targetSize) or "return_label" and share the pickup confirmation with the customer. Refunds settle in 3-5 business days after pickup.

knowledgeBase.title: Customer Dissatisfaction & Human Specialist Handoff
knowledgeBase.summary: When to immediately escalate to a human support specialist.
knowledgeBase.content: If a customer says they are not satisfied with the automated answer, asks to speak to a human/manager, or disputes a refund timeline past 5 business days, immediately call request_human_assistance so Priya S. takes over the thread.

companyPolicies.title: Terms and Conditions
companyPolicies.summary: Storefront usage, pricing in INR, authentic product guarantees, and dispute resolution.
companyPolicies.content: All prices on Threadora are listed in Indian Rupees (INR) inclusive of GST. Orders are confirmed upon payment authorization. Promotional discounts cannot be stacked unless stated. Any billing discrepancies or duplicate settlements are resolved immediately via DeskPilot automated verification or finance audit.

companyPolicies.title: Privacy Policy
companyPolicies.summary: Customer data protection, payment security, and account deletion rights.
companyPolicies.content: We collect only essential order details (name, email, shipping address, and order history) required to fulfill deliveries and provide support. Card and UPI details are processed over PCI-DSS compliant gateways and never stored in plain text. Customers may request address updates or data export/deletion anytime through support.

companyPolicies.title: Customer support policy
companyPolicies.summary: Autonomous instant resolution targets and immediate escalation for urgent/critical cases.
companyPolicies.content: DeskPilot AI handles routine inquiries, order tracking, payment syncs, exchanges, and eligible refunds autonomously 24/7 in English and Hinglish with zero wait time. Urgent or critical cases (sentiment score <= 30, P1 billing/fraud disputes, or explicit requests for human assistance) trigger immediate escalation and live admin notification.

companyPolicies.title: ORDER CANCELLATION POLICY
companyPolicies.summary: Instant cancellation before courier dispatch with automatic 100% refund.
companyPolicies.content: Orders in "Payment Pending", "Confirmed", or "Packed · Ships Today" status can be cancelled immediately at zero fee—the automated system should cancel the order and trigger a full refund back to the original payment method (3-5 business days). Once an order reaches "Shipped" or "Delivered", cancellation is unavailable and customers should be offered a free 14-day return label upon delivery.

companyPolicies.title: WARRANTY POLICY
companyPolicies.summary: 6-month craftsmanship warranty covering seam defects, buttons, and fabric faults.
companyPolicies.content: All Threadora garments and accessories carry a 6-month craftsmanship warranty against stitching unraveling, horn/metal hardware failure, or premature seam defects. Normal wear-and-tear or improper washing (such as machine-drying merino wool) is excluded. Valid defect claims on delivered orders qualify for a free instant warranty replacement.

companyPolicies.title: SHIPPING & DELIVERY POLICY
companyPolicies.summary: Free pan-India dispatch within 24 hours; 2-4 days metro and 4-7 days nationwide.
companyPolicies.content: In-stock orders ship free across India within 24 business hours via BlueDart or Delhivery. Estimated delivery is 2-4 business days for metro cities (Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Pune, Hyderabad) and 4-7 business days for other PIN codes. Tracking codes (BD-XXXX-IN) activate within 4 hours of courier pickup.
